turns.q: Is there anything else a beginner needs to get started?
turns.replyTail:
Agent

For a beginner, it's important to ensure you have a suitable foundation. DreamCloud mattresses are easy to set up on most foundations, bed bases (including slatted or divan), or adjustable frames. If using a slatted base, the maximum distance between slats should be 9cm and the minimum slat width 5cm. Also, please note that DreamCloud is a plush mattress, so make sure your frame can fit a 25cm-29cm mattress. We do not recommend using your DreamCloud on the floor.
